data.name: ULTRAWORLD EXODUS
data.detailed_description:
ULTRAWORLD EXODUS is now free!

ULTRAWORLD EXODUS is now free! 100% free, no strings attached!

I consider this game a personal work of Art, and I want everyone to get in there and try it! Fair warning: it's weird and awkward, (and not always in a charming way), but hey, it's free right? So give it a shot anyway.

For everyone who bought the game before it went free, you've been granted the soundtrack DLC for free. The soundtrack is still $5. I left a price tag on it for people who think it's worth a damn and/or want to support me as a creator.

Thanks!
James Beech
Creator of ULTRAWORLD


Acerca do jogo

The doors to ULTRAWORLD are open and beckon you to return. Come see what's new in ULTRAWORLD EXODUS, a free addition to the wildly abstract first-person exploration adventure you've heard so little about. Created by a AAA game dev veteran that you've never heard of and certainly don't care about, ULTRAWORLD EXODUS is a relaxing stoll/Art toy/posturing philosophical treatise/who-knows-what.

FEATURING

IMPERFECT: A highly revised redux of the original ULTRAWORLD story. Ponder Exoplanets and Artificial Intelligence while trying to assist a self-aware NPC in the midst of an existential crisis. Some people loved it. Some people hated it. Feel free to decide for yourself.

EXODUS: A new continuation of the unusual sci-fi meta-narrative that could only be told in the medium of video games. A year has passed and ULTRAWORLD has changed. Your old pal is dismayed by your inaction, but this gives way to a new friend with an impossible plan. Embrace the future!

VACATION MODE: A greatly expanded free-roaming mode where you're the Artist. Change the colors, filters, particles, and rendering modes for infinite visual variety (and I do mean infinite). Then soar above the landscape, camera in hand, looking for the perfect picture. Every shot is a unique abstract painting, created by you, and fit to hang on your walls.

THE SOUNDTRACK: There are now double the songs to the highly praised original soundtrack.

VR SUPPORT: Vacation Mode can be setup to use VR devices (although you'll need a steel stomach. Not meant for humans)

Now get out there and find your painting!

data.short_description: Visit a first-person, abstract landscape of bleeding technicolor wonder, armed with a camera, curiosity, and freedom. Explore at your own pace or experience the story that has confounded players and critics alike. Get lost in another reality.

reviews.review:
Jack the Ripper. The Hanging Gardens of Babylon. Amy Schumer's success. 

Our world already is rich in mysteries, but a new contender appears in the fog, prepared to make it into the ranks of mankinds most important issues. Why, why the fuck, does this little indie gem receive "mixed" reviews and a 6/10, when it's F R E E?
I've played several free indie games on steam and this one strikes me as one of the most interesting, pleasant, colourfull and enjoyable experiences.

The game looks gorgeous, runs smoothly, is clearly structured, offers some nice philosophical discussion without trying to be profound and the soundtrack could have been a few tracks longer but sets the different moods perfectly, vibrant electronic beats with proper production and nice synthies. Having said that, of course it's more an excursus, experiment or "world explorer" than a game in the "traditional" sense, but you probably got that when you read the title. The game keeps motivating you via storytelling and instant feedback and while I didn't find the way to the final piece of the second story, it still was a rewarding experience, both visually and contentwise.

When my 84 minutes of first-run-content are filled with such great art direction and lightning without ever crashing or lagging, I'm more than happy to pay a few bucks for it, so it really is baffling to me that people can't appreciate this thought-provoking, stylishly built, well-written visual feast for the hefty price of nothing but their time. 8/10 for sure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows Vista SP1, Windows 7 or Windows 8.1 (64bit only)
  • Processador: Intel Dual-Core 2GHz or AMD Dual-Core 2GHz
  • Memória: 4 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: NVIDIA GeForce 400 series or AMD Radeon HD 6000 series (DirectX11 Compatible)
  • DirectX: Versão 11
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 1 GB de espaço livre
  • Placa de som: DirectX Compatible Sound Card with latest drivers
  • Notas adicionais: WARNING: Game will not run unless you have 4GB of Memory and a DirectX11 OS/Graphics card

  • Processador: Intel Quad-Core (i5 2300) or AMD Octo-Core (FX 8150)
  • Memória: 8 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: NVIDIA GeForce 660Ti or greater, AMD Radeon HD 7950 or greater (DirectX11 Compatible)
